patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Adapt.io and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than Instantly's shape. Choose Instantly only if your buying job matches “Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans data-enrichment, contact-management; Instantly leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; Instantly is Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358; bundles/credits add-ons; Enterprise custom..
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning data-enrichment, contact-management vs Instantly-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; Instantly — Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core.

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; Instantly: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Lead finder/credits are add-on depth vs dedicated SI databases.

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · Instantly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need Instantly's motion (Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
